# Semgrep rule packs

<!-- Generated by `npm run build` (mcp/test/docs/generate.ts). Do not edit by hand. -->

dev-guardian ships **150 rules in 11 packs** under [`configs/semgrep/`](../configs/semgrep/). Messages and comments are in Portuguese; each pack's header comment records what was measured, against which corpus, and why each exclusion exists.

**29 of the 150 rules** have no clause the ablation harness (`npm run ablate`, see [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md)) can remove — 23 are a bare `pattern` / `pattern-regex` and 6 a `patterns` group of positive terms only. Those rules are checked by axis 0 (the rule fires on its `hits/` fixtures) and nothing else.

| Pack | Run by | Rules | With ablatable clauses | With none | Languages | Severity |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| [`base`](#base) | `scan_sast`, once `init_project` has installed it as the project's `.semgrep.yml` | 13 | 7 | 6 | generic, javascript, php, python, typescript | 7 ERROR, 1 INFO, 5 WARNING |
| [`bugfix-cs`](#bugfix-cs) | `bug_hunt` | 11 | 10 | 1 | csharp | 1 ERROR, 10 WARNING |
| [`bugfix-go`](#bugfix-go) | `bug_hunt` | 9 | 8 | 1 | go | 1 ERROR, 8 WARNING |
| [`bugfix-java`](#bugfix-java) | `bug_hunt` | 7 | 7 | 0 | java | 7 WARNING |
| [`bugfix-js`](#bugfix-js) | `bug_hunt` | 13 | 12 | 1 | javascript, typescript | 1 ERROR, 1 INFO, 11 WARNING |
| [`bugfix-php`](#bugfix-php) | `bug_hunt` | 6 | 6 | 0 | php | 6 WARNING |
| [`bugfix-py`](#bugfix-py) | `bug_hunt` | 10 | 10 | 0 | python | 1 ERROR, 9 WARNING |
| [`bugfix-rs`](#bugfix-rs) | `bug_hunt` | 1 | 1 | 0 | rust | 1 WARNING |
| [`llm`](#llm) | `scan_sast` (and so `security_scan_full` and `review_pr`), on every native Semgrep run | 8 | 8 | 0 | javascript, python, typescript | 3 LOW, 5 WARNING |
| [`rgpd`](#rgpd) | `compliance_check` | 8 | 8 | 0 | csharp, generic, javascript, php, python, typescript | 8 WARNING |
| [`routes`](#routes) | `map_attack_surface` (and so `scan_dast` and `validate_finding`) | 64 | 44 | 20 | csharp, go, java, javascript, php, python, ruby, rust, typescript | 64 INFO |
| **total** | | **150** | **121** | **29** | | |
